assumptions.albedo: albedo 0.16, the user's guide default; not held for the site
assumptions.boundary_layer: boundary layer calculated by the engine from the surface record and sun angle (BL_TYPE CALC); the forecast's mixingHeight is not used
assumptions.bowen: Bowen ratio 0.6, the user's guide default; not held for the site
assumptions.land_use: no land-use or canopy data (LANDUSE not set, no canopy); no held land-cover source is read
assumptions.large_scale: no large-scale variability (ENSM_TYPE NONE, the README's practice for small domains): the probability covers turbulent fluctuation, not uncertainty in the forecast wind
assumptions.material: an ideal gas at the air temperature, no deposition, no decay
assumptions.precipitation: dry: the forecast's quantitative precipitation is zero over the run (a wet forecast is refused)
assumptions.single_station: one surface station at the release: the forecast is uniform over the domain at each hour
assumptions.source: the two-phase jet as a dense gas from where its aerosol has evaporated (technical documentation section 13.4's cone method); no aerosol or liquid class
assumptions.terrain: flat terrain; no terrain file (tersci and an elevation grid are not held)
